verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
OBUDDE buzibye;Yesu
Njijja ne mu maaso go,
Mu kizikiza n'ekisa,
Kuuma nze omuddu wo,

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Mwana gw'endiga,gw'osinga
Okubeera omulungi;
Ggwe wansasiira;nnali nga
Naatera kufa bufi.

verse.name: v5
verse.lines:
Buli kye tukoze olabye,
Buli kye tukwonoonye;
Bwe tukyalaba,tusaba,
Yesu,otusonyiwe.
